title: ELO Feature Anchoring + Rolling-5 Form Group in GA Evolution
problem: GA evolution can drop high-value features during mutation/crossover. Research consistently shows team_elo, team_elo_5y, and home_next are top-3 features across all NBA prediction models (SHAP analysis, multiple 2025-2026 papers). If GA drops these, it wastes generations re-discovering them.

evidence.source: Integration of machine learning XGBoost and SHAP for NBA prediction (PMC, 2024)
evidence.finding: home_next, team_elo_5_y, team_elo consistently top-3 SHAP features across all model types

evidence.source: Key Factors Influencing NBA Game Outcomes (Preprints.org, Apr 2025)
evidence.finding: Win streaks, home-court advantage, shooting efficiency are primary predictors. Rolling 5-game form captures short-term momentum.

evidence.source: Uncertainty-Aware ML for NBA Forecasting (MDPI Information, Jan 2026)
evidence.finding: Rolling five-game averages for pace, possessions, point differential capture short-term form. Headline sentiment excluded (weak signal).

evidence.source: Stacked ensemble model for NBA outcomes (Nature Scientific Reports, 2025)
evidence.finding: SHAP interpretability confirms ELO-based features + home court provide stable signal across 8+ seasons.

proposed_changes.description: Define LOCKED_FEATURES list containing feature name patterns for elo and home_next. In mutate() and crossover(), never flip these bits to 0. In init(), always seed these bits as 1.
proposed_changes.expected_impact: Prevents wasted generations from ELO dropout. Ensures proven features are always in pool.

proposed_changes.change: Add rolling-5 pace/possessions group to feature engine (Cat46)
proposed_changes.description: 2026 paper recommends rolling 5-game averages for: pace, projected_possessions, point_differential, total_points. Add as new Cat46 in engine.py.
proposed_changes.expected_impact: ~36 new features capturing form signal validated by Jan 2026 paper. Low compute cost.
proposed_changes.parity_note: Must update BOTH features/engine.py AND hf-space/features/engine.py to maintain engine parity.

implementation_order: 1. Add LOCKED_FEATURES to S10 (exploitation island) first — least risk
2. Monitor 5 cycles — measure if brier improves vs S11 control
3. If positive: deploy to all 6 islands
4. Add Cat46 to engine.py + deploy — separate change, separate cycle
estimated_brier_impact: -0.001 to -0.003 (prevents ELO dropout waste, tighter convergence)
